description: The twelve playable species of Nymedes. Nine modify their SRD 5.2.1 counterparts; three (Araag, Loroka, Elestu) are new. Every species carries a Destiny Base of 2; the Elf, the Human and the Halfling each carry one additional Destiny power.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fast Learner
traits.text: You gain 2 skill points at levels 1, 3 and 6.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.text: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Soulforged Affinity
traits.text: You can Body Forge a Soulgem into your own flesh at no cost in Hit Points.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fast Learner
traits.text: You gain 2 skill points at levels 1, 3 and 6.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Survival, Delve, or Vigilance skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

changes.data.traits[keen-senses].text: You have proficiency in the Survival, Delve, or Vigilance skill.

data[fh_traits].name: Splinter of Anon
data[fh_traits].text: Your Destiny Base increases by 2, for a Destiny Base of 4 at character creation.

data[fh_traits].name: Outlasting
data[fh_traits].text: You have Advantage on Chaos rolls.

data[fh_traits].name: Educated
data[fh_traits].text: You gain 2 skill points at character creation.

data[fh_traits].name: Twice-Born
data[fh_traits].text: You recover 2 Destiny Points on a Long Rest instead of 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.text: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see “Feats”). Skilled is recommended.
